unavailablePolicy: display disabled; do not promise an effect

settings.label: Unrestricted break-blow close-ups
settings.description: Bypass the character-property restriction on break-blow facial close-ups for HON/MAR/NIC/SNK and Minato (MNT), confirmed in-game. Uses validated LR code patterns; an unknown build skips this patch. Restart required.

settings.label: Character slot and mod labels
settings.description: Show costume/hair slot codes and the selected Layer2 mod in character select.

settings.label: Stage slot labels
settings.description: Show the highlighted stage code in stage select. Stage Layer2 loading is not yet ported, so named stages show Mod: Vanilla. Restart required.

settings.label: Survival stage
settings.description: This allow to set a different stage for survival mode. Default value is default game behavior (colosseum stage) The value can be a stage code -> Eg: survival_stage = S1601ISL It can also be a mod path -> Eg: survival_stage = "My Stage" If your stage is at a subfolder inside Layer2, then that folder name must also be specified -> E.g: survival_stage = "STAGES/My Stage" Special stage codes of REDELBE also work. Eg (to load colosseum night): survival_stage = S0401CLS
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Disable splash
settings.description: If true, the splash screen won't be shown.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: F5 battle HUD toggle
settings.description: Press F5 to hide or restore battle HUD and training/replay overlays. The HUD starts visible. Independent of Layer2 keyboard controls. Restart after enabling/disabling this shortcut.

settings.label: Random Layer2 costumes
settings.description: Include Layer2 costumes plus Vanilla in the game Random character selection, in offline Versus and Free Training.

settings.label: Enable random underwear
settings.description: if enabled, and the costume (either vanilla or mod) has alternative underwears, the underwear will be randomized in random selections (both player and cpu)
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Enable random hair
settings.description: If enabled, randomization will be applied to hair styles in random selections (both player and cpu). You can configure further options in [RandomHair]
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Enable random glasses
settings.description: If enable, randmization will be applied to glasses in random selections (both player and cpu). You can configure further options in [RandomGlasses]
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Enable random stage mods
settings.description: If enabled, Layer2 stage mods will count towards random selection of stages (both randomness selected by player or cpu)
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Enable random music
settings.description: If enabled, music will be randomized following the rules at [RandomMusic] section
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Probability
settings.description: ;;;;;;;; THIS SECTION IS ONLY MEANINGFUL if enable_random_hair = true in [Random] Otherwise, everything in here is ignored. ;;;;;;;; This is the percentage that randomization will be applied to hair. If the probability evaluates to true, a random hair, from all available to current costume, will be selected, including the default hair of the current costume. If the probability evaluates to false, the default hair for that costume will be selected (default game behavior)
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Allow mods
settings.description: If true, hair mods will be included in the randomization. If false, they will be excluded.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Probability
settings.description: ;;;;;;;; THIS SECTION IS ONLY MEANINGFUL if enable_random_glasses = true in [Random] Otherwise, everything in here is ignored. ;;;;;;;; This is the percentage that randomization will be applied to glasses. For costumes without default glasses, this is the probability that a glasses from the list below will be chosen. For costumes with default glasses, this is the probability that a different glasses than default one will be chosen from the list below, and "no glasses" is also added to the random list in this case.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Kas
settings.description: List of glasses for characters. When a random glass is chosen, it will be chosen from the list here. You can configure this list to your liking if you want X character to get glasses from other characters. Use a "," to separate multiple items
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: THIS SECTION IS ONLY MEANINGFUL if enable_random_music = true in [Random] Otherwise, everything in here is ignored. ;;;;;;;; The mode. Currently, this can be one of these two values: mix and full mix -> the music will be randomized between the stage or character bgm, where the probability for the stage is given by "mix_stage_probability", and the probability for character music is 100 - mix_stage_probability full -> the music will be chosen randomly from the list in the file REDELBE/random_tracks.txt fullmix -> the music will be randomized based by character/stage from the list in the file REDELBE /fullmix.ini.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Stage probability
settings.description: If mode is mix or fullmix, this is the probability that the stage theme will be chosen over the character theme. Please note that if the characters don't have a theme, this effectively becomes 100.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Log mod resource access
settings.description: Log LR Layer2 overrides, Vanilla fallbacks, and resource redirects.

settings.label: Log loose resource opens
settings.description: Log opens of LR fdata_package/data resource files; not original DOA6 RDB semantics.

settings.label: Log archive container opens
settings.description: Log opens of LR packed archive containers (first 4,000 opens per run). Does not trace individual packed resource reads.

settings.label: Log numeric
settings.description: Logs access to the (mostly encrypted) .bin files in numeric folders (these are outside rdb filesystem) Unlike other log options, this one will be logged in every read attempt along with file position and number of bytes requested. Cost: irrelevant except when playing videos of story mode, where it would become low/average.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Enable exception handler
settings.description: ;;;;;;;;;; FROM HERE IT IS ADVANCED STUFF. DO NOT TOUCH IF YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT THESE SETTINGS MEAN ;;;;;;;;;;;;;; ;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;; Enables exception handler (will log a crash to the log file).
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Enable cpp exception hook
settings.description: If enabled, REDELBE will be able to print a C++ exception message to the log file, before the game does a "high level crash".
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Cpp exception stack trace level
settings.description: If enable_cpp_exception_hook=true, REDELBE will (try to) trace back this many calls when the exception happens.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Dump keys
settings.description: Encryption Dumps all AES256-CBC keys/IV to the log file.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Dump all decrypted
settings.description: Dumps all encrypted content after it has been decrypted. Data is stored in REDELBE/DECRYPTED.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Auto uncompress decrypted
settings.description: If true, and zlib data is detected after decryption, it will be automatically uncompressed before being dumped (this setting won't do anything unless dump_all_decrypted = true)
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Debug script
settings.description: Prints to the log the script calls to native functions (and only native), for debugging purposes. WARNING: this will cause a LOT of writes to the log file. It may slow down the game, specially on low spec systems. Also, the log file size will increase a lot, only enable this for short game sessiones (< 5 minutes).
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Hunt hashes
settings.description: It will print to the log the call to the string hash functions.
settings.reason: Original DOA6 option; not implemented by the LR loader.

settings.label: Custom roster animations
settings.description: On: use custom Accessories transitions, handoff fade and highlighted-portrait reveal. Off: use the original game roster animations and visibility; all custom roster controls are ignored. Restart after changing.

settings.label: Accessories opens
settings.description: Choose the normal game transition or an instant roster change.

settings.label: Back from Accessories
settings.description: Choose the normal game transition or an instant roster change.

settings.label: Player 1 ready → Player 2 selection
settings.description: Fade or instantly show the roster when Player 1 confirms.

settings.label: Reveal highlighted portrait during fade
settings.description: During the handoff fade, reveal the P2 highlighted portrait immediately. Moving away hides it, then it fades back over the remaining transition. Selecting a character ends the fade.

settings.label: Handoff fade duration (ms)
settings.description: Length of the Player 1 to Player 2 fade.

settings.label: Costume Layer2 cycling
settings.description: Allow manual Layer2 costume selection.

settings.label: Hair/head Layer2 cycling
settings.description: Allow manual Layer2 hair/head selection in Accessories.

settings.label: Keyboard mod controls
settings.description: F cycles Layer2 mods.

settings.label: Gamepad mod controls
settings.description: LT/L2 cycles forward and Select/Back cycles backward.

settings.label: Show loader title label
settings.description: Display the loader name/version beside the game version.

settings.label: Log UI animation events
settings.description: Verbose UI tracing. Normal startup, error, selection and roster-transition logs remain enabled.

settings.label: Hair color storage
settings.description: Full palette: approximately 27 GB. Cache: generate selected colors on demand with a 1 GB limit. Run Prepare Hair Colors after switching modes.

settings.label: Random CPU hair colors
settings.description: Offline Versus CPUs only. Requires the full palette. Does not change hairstyles or saved wardrobe choices.

settings.label: CPU color probability
settings.description: 1 is a 1% chance; 100 always chooses a different custom color. Requires Random.enable_random_hair_colors=true and full storage mode.
